title: Correct Ollama thinking discovery and investigate IFM controls
description: The application reads the legacy thinking_levels field rather than the documented thinking object. The installed IFM 3.7B runtime currently advertises neither field; resolving its controls also requires runtime/template investigation. Preserve verified default/disabled behavior until supported controls are established.
acceptance_criteria: Given canonical thinking metadata, when capabilities are normalized, then documented boolean and named controls/defaults are represented accurately.
Given absent or malformed metadata, when verification runs, then unsupported controls are never inferred from successful fallback alone.
Given the exact IFM 7B artifact, when runtime controls are investigated, then accepted requests and actual template behavior are distinguished from model-family claims.

Given different model capabilities, when selecting an effort, then the UI and backend use that model only; the three GPT-5.6 models retain their documented xhigh/max settings while IFM rejects unsupported levels.
test_cases: Modern metadata, boolean controls, named values, omission/malformed responses and explicit default semantics.
Opt-in 7B runtime verification; no additional weights downloaded without authorization.
Per-model hosted capability isolation; xhigh/max hosted payloads and local/hosted switching.
verification: Official documentation inspected; current Python parser confirmed against source. Read-only /api/show on installed IFM 3.7B omitted thinking metadata and reported tools/completion. Earlier 7B named-parameter rejection remains a measured result for the pinned build. No behavioral change or new generation test executed in this investigation.
